style: Minimal ivory-and-gold pictograms in the shared achievement badge frame.

notes.underwater: Below 50 TR, confirmed by the user. The emblem intentionally has no numeric threshold.
notes.theBigTable: A five-player game in a tournament with a Final, as requested.
notes.beatTheFryx: The F is a name cue, paired with a victory check; no portrait or likeness.
notes.welcomeToMars: A first-landing bootprint is the welcoming flavor metaphor; the description retains the last-place requirement.

rules.from-behind: Won while last in the match.players turn-order array. Use the actual table size rather than a fixed seat number.
rules.martian-flu: Starts from an organizer-chosen patient zero. Playing a recorded match against a currently infected player transfers the fictional Martian Flu regardless of result, from that match onward. Process contacts chronologically; artwork only, infection-state design remains pending.
rules.fresh-faces: Formerly Clean Slate. Complete all three qualifying rounds (Rounds 1, 2 and 3). Collect opponents at each shared table, excluding yourself; no opponent may recur across these rounds. A partial tournament does not qualify. Exclude the Final.
rules.so-we-meet-again: At least one opponent appears with you in two distinct recorded matches in different rounds of the same tournament. A Final may be the repeat encounter. Compare player identity within the tournament; no cross-tournament account history is needed.
rules.growth-mindset: Complete all qualifying rounds. terraform_rating must strictly increase between each consecutive qualifying round (Round 1 < Round 2 < Round 3). The Final is excluded; a tied TR total does not qualify.
rules.climbing-the-ranks: Complete all qualifying rounds. Recorded finishing position must strictly improve each round, so the position numbers decrease (e.g. 3 > 2 > 1). The Final is excluded; equal positions do not qualify. Separate from Growth Mindset, which measures TR.
rules.patient-zero: An organizer designates exactly one original Martian Flu carrier and records that player identity and the seed time. Only that original carrier receives Patient Zero, and also receives Martian Flu. Patient Zero does not transfer to later contacts and is not recomputed from the earliest imported match. Artwork and rule definition only; infection-state implementation remains pending.
rules.redemption: Two completed matches in different rounds of the same tournament share this player and the same opponent. In the earlier match your position is numerically greater than theirs; in the later match it is strictly lower. Ties do not count as beating or losing to that opponent. A played Final may be the later match. You need not win the whole table. No linked cross-tournament history is required.
rules.second-wind: In a completed qualifying round r, your position equals the largest recorded position at your table and is greater than 1; this includes joint last, but not a whole table tied for first. In the very next scheduled qualifying round r+1, your position is 1. Both results must exist; do not skip a missing round. Exclude Finals and byes. A recorded shared win counts as position 1.
rules.hidden-gem: Award in a completed qualifying round only when at least two tables have completed played results. Across all played matches in that tournament and round, the player’s canonical corporation must be selected by exactly one distinct player: that player. The player must finish position 1; shared first place qualifies. Wait for all played results and corporation selections in the round to be confirmed; unknown selections do not count as unique. Check uniqueness across the whole round, not just the winner’s table. Exclude single-table qualifying rounds and Finals. The achievement can be earned again in each qualifying round.

notes.names: Backseat is the current catalogue name for From Behind; its stable from-behind asset ID and artwork are retained. Fresh Faces replaces the provisional name Clean Slate. Climbing the Ranks names the placement counterpart to Growth Mindset.
